line.satsujinki.anxious.1: I have a really bad feeling
line.satsujinki.anxious.4: I feel like I'm being watched
line.satsujinki.anxious.6: This is a joke, let me out!
line.satsujinki.beg.2: I'll pay it all back, I swear...
line.satsujinki.beg.4: I'll never do anything bad again...
line.satsujinki.bribe.1: A hundred million... no, a billion!
line.satsujinki.bribe.2: Save me and you will never work again!
line.satsujinki.calm.3: It smells like iron in here
line.satsujinki.calm.5: What game are they talking about?
line.satsujinki.calm.6: They said my debts would be wiped...
line.satsujinki.calm.7: A hundred million yen prize... really?
line.satsujinki.grabbed.3: Put me down! PUT ME DOWN!
line.satsujinki.grabbed.6: Not in there! Anything but that!
line.satsujinki.intro.gyaru.0: Seriously, this is SO not okay!
line.satsujinki.intro.gyaru.1: No signal here? Worst day ever
line.satsujinki.intro.macho.1: Muscles will get me through any trial!
line.satsujinki.intro.office_lady.0: They said I could leave on time...
line.satsujinki.intro.ojisan.1: My back hurts... let me sit down
line.satsujinki.intro.otaku.0: It's the limited edition release day...
line.satsujinki.intro.otaku.1: Is this the prologue to an isekai...?
line.satsujinki.intro.president.0: Do you know who I am?!
line.satsujinki.intro.president.1: How much do you want? Name your price
line.satsujinki.intro.salaryman.0: I have a big presentation tomorrow... let me go
line.satsujinki.intro.yankee.0: Huh? Where's this? Who dragged me here
line.satsujinki.intro.yankee.1: Fine. I'll take you all on
line.satsujinki.panic.2: I don't want to die! I don't want to die!
line.satsujinki.trap.2: That plate up there won't fall... right?
